claims.text: The resort is set on a clifftop plateau along the southern coastline of Bali's Bukit Peninsula.

findings.quote: Set on a clifftop plateau along the southern coastline on Bali’s Bukit Peninsula, Alila Villas Uluwatu serves breathtaking coastal vistas
findings.note: The official page states the clifftop plateau location on the Bukit Peninsula's southern coastline.

claims.text: It is an all-villa resort set high on a cliff.

findings.quote: The striking latticework rectangles of this all-villa resort, set high on a cliff, has become an icon for contemporary Bali.
findings.note: Condé Nast Traveler describes it as an all-villa resort set high on a cliff.

claims.text: The resort was designed by Singapore-based WOHA Architects to exist in harmony with its natural surroundings.

findings.quote: Designed by award-winning Singapore-based WOHA Architects to exist in harmony with its natural surroundings
findings.note: Names the architects, their Singapore base and the design intent.

claims.text: Villas use locally sourced materials such as lava rock roofs and bamboo ceilings that circulate sea breezes.

findings.quote: locally sourced materials like unique lava rock roofs and bamboo ceilings that circulate gentle sea breezes throughout the villa
findings.note: The villa description covers all the named materials and the breeze circulation.

claims.text: Villa guests are looked after by a 24-hour Villa Host service.

findings.quote: complemented by the personalised care of our 24-hour Villa Host service
findings.note: The rooms page mentions the 24-hour Villa Host service.

findings.quote: the attentive care of your dedicated 24-hour Villa Host
findings.note: The 24-hour Villa Host is also mentioned in the family package.

claims.text: The resort has a cliffside infinity pool.

findings.quote: relax by the cliffside infinity pool
findings.note: The official page mentions the cliffside infinity pool.

claims.text: Spa Alila engages local spa therapists who draw on age-old Balinese traditions.

findings.quote: engaging local spa therapists—the keepers of age-old traditions and concoctions—to share effective and soothing therapies with guests
findings.note: Establishes that local therapists are the keepers of age-old traditions.

findings.quote: Time-honored Balinese practices inform every treatment and technique
findings.note: Confirms the traditions are Balinese.

claims.text: The spa has a steam room and a hammam.

findings.quote: There's a spa with a steam room and hammam.
findings.note: The editorial review states that the spa has both.

claims.text: The fitness center includes dedicated yoga and meditation studios.

findings.quote: Our 24-hour fitness center includes dedicated yoga and meditation studios
findings.note: Directly stated.

claims.text: Guests can take part in interactive experiences in the resort's Sustainability Lab and Organic Garden.

findings.quote: takes you through interactive experiences in our Sustainability Lab and Organic Garden
findings.note: Directly stated in the Alila Moments description.

claims.text: A filtration and bottling system keeps the property plastic-free.

findings.quote: the impressive filtration and bottling system that keep the property plastic-free
findings.note: The editorial review states this directly.

claims.text: The Warung restaurant serves Indonesian and Balinese flavours.

findings.quote: Featuring the rich variety of vibrant Indonesian and Balinese flavours
findings.note: From The Warung's description on the dining page.

claims.text: The Cliff Edge Spa Cabana is perched on the side of the Uluwatu cliff with a view of the Indian Ocean.

findings.quote: perched on the side of the Uluwatu cliff with a breathtaking view of the Indian Ocean
findings.note: From the Cliff Edge Spa Cabana description.

claims.text: The villas feature private pools, cabanas and terraces.

findings.quote: Our villas feature private pools, cabanas and terraces for the ultimate in comfort and space.
findings.note: Directly stated.

claims.text: At check-in, guests choose their service style: private, discreet or indulgent.

findings.quote: categorized into "private," "discreet," or "indulgent."
findings.note: The review says guests are asked at check-in, and lists these three categories.

claims.text: An Alila Moments day of Balinese spirituality includes sacred cleansing, traditional crafts, temple offerings and a Kecak performance at sunset.

findings.quote: a day that begins with sacred cleansing and continues with traditional crafts, temple offerings, local cuisine and a mesmerizing Kecak performance at sunset
findings.note: Covers all the listed elements of The Spiritual Essence of Bali moment.

claims.text: Sunset Cabana Bar serves artisanal cocktails perched over the cliff edge overlooking the Indian Ocean.

findings.quote: Enjoy an evening of sublime artisanal cocktails at Sunset Cabana Bar perched over the cliff edge overlooking the Indian Ocean.
findings.note: Directly stated.

claims.text: The sea is reached by a 600-step cliff-hugging stairway.

findings.quote: it’s only 600 steps down the cliff-hugging stairway to get to it.
findings.note: The editorial review gives the 600-step cliff-hugging stairway to the sea.
